[binaries]
c = '/src/third_party/musl-cross-x86_64/bin/x86_64-linux-musl-gcc'
cpp = '/src/third_party/musl-cross-x86_64/bin/x86_64-linux-musl-g++'
ar = '/src/third_party/musl-cross-x86_64/bin/x86_64-linux-musl-ar'
strip = '/src/third_party/musl-cross-x86_64/bin/x86_64-linux-musl-strip'
# meson <0.64 spells this key `pkgconfig`; newer versions accept `pkg-config`.
# Give it both, or dependency lookup silently falls back to the host's.
pkgconfig = '/src/third_party/dos-pkgconfig'
pkg-config = '/src/third_party/dos-pkgconfig'

[host_machine]
system = 'linux'
cpu_family = 'x86_64'
cpu = 'x86_64'
endian = 'little'
